title: The Journey of a Water Drop
blurb: A tiny drop of water goes up, up into the sky and comes back down. What happens on the way?

chapters.title: Up from the Sea
chapters.text:
Meet Drip. Drip is a drop of water in the sea. The sea is big and blue. Many fish swim around Drip.

The sun shines on the sea. The sun is hot. It warms the water. When water gets warm, some of it turns into a gas. The gas is called water vapour. You cannot see it.

Drip is warm now. Drip turns into water vapour. Up, up, up goes Drip! The water vapour rises into the sky. Salt stays behind in the sea.

questions.prompt: Where does Drip live at the start?
questions.why: Drip is a drop of water in the sea.

questions.prompt: What warms the water?
questions.why: The sun is hot. It warms the water.

questions.prompt: What is a gas made from water called?
questions.why: The gas is called water vapour.

questions.prompt: Can you see water vapour?
questions.why: The text says you cannot see it.

questions.prompt: Which way does the water vapour go?
questions.why: The water vapour rises into the sky.

questions.prompt: What stays behind in the sea?
questions.why: Salt stays behind in the sea.

questions.prompt: What makes some of the water turn into vapour?
questions.why: When water gets warm, some of it turns into a gas.

chapters.title: Drip Makes a Cloud
chapters.text:
High in the sky, the air is cold. The cold air changes the water vapour back into tiny drops of water. This is called condensation.

Drip meets millions of other drops. They stay close together. Together they make a cloud. A cloud is full of tiny water drops. The drops are so light that the cloud floats.

The wind blows the cloud over the land. The cloud passes over houses, fields and a big green mountain. Drip looks down and sees the world far below.

questions.prompt: What is the air like high in the sky?
questions.why: High in the sky, the air is cold.

questions.prompt: What does the cold air do to water vapour?
options: It changes it back into tiny drops of water
questions.why: The cold air changes the water vapour back into tiny drops.

questions.prompt: What is the change from vapour back to drops called?
questions.why: This is called condensation.

questions.prompt: What is a cloud made of?
questions.why: A cloud is full of tiny water drops.

questions.prompt: Why does the cloud float?
options: It is tied to a mountain
questions.why: The drops are so light that the cloud floats.

questions.prompt: What moves the cloud over the land?
questions.why: The wind blows the cloud over the land.

questions.prompt: What does Drip see below?
options: Houses, fields and a green mountain
questions.why: Drip sees houses, fields and a big green mountain.

chapters.title: Rain Comes Home
chapters.text:
The cloud meets a tall mountain. The air is very cold there. The tiny drops join together and grow bigger and bigger. At last they are too heavy to float.

Plop! Drip falls from the cloud. It is rain! Drip lands on a leaf. Then Drip slides down into a stream.

The stream runs down the mountain into a river. The river flows back to the sea. Drip is home again, and the journey can begin once more. The journey of water goes round and round. It is called the water cycle.

questions.prompt: What do the drops do in the cold air?
options: They join together and grow bigger
questions.why: The tiny drops join together and grow bigger and bigger.

questions.prompt: Why do the drops fall from the cloud?
options: They are too heavy to float
questions.why: At last they are too heavy to float.

questions.prompt: What do we call the water that falls?
questions.why: The text says, "It is rain!"

questions.prompt: Where does Drip land first?
questions.why: Drip lands on a leaf.

questions.prompt: Where does the stream go?
options: Down into a river and back to the sea
questions.why: The stream runs into a river and the river flows back to the sea.

questions.prompt: What is the journey of water called?
questions.why: The text calls it the water cycle.

questions.prompt: What can happen to Drip once more at the end?
questions.why: Drip is home again, and the journey can begin once more.
